title: Imperative kubectl
summary: One command per line, each missing the flag or word that makes it do the job. In the exam these are faster than writing YAML, and with --dry-run=client -o yaml they write the YAML for you.

image.clue: A Deployment of nginx with three replicas

command.clue: A Pod whose words after -- replace the image's entrypoint, not just its arguments

from.clue: Start a Job now from the CronJob pi's template

target-port.clue: A Service on port 80 that forwards to the containers' port 8080

from-literal.clue: A ConfigMap with one key given on the command line

generic.clue: An opaque Secret of key-value pairs, not a TLS or registry Secret

replicas.clue: Run five Pods of the Deployment

resource.clue: A Role that may read Pods

rule.clue: Send everything for one host to the Service web

recursive.clue: Show every field below this one, not just the next level
